title: BPAN — improving DQN on the Bintulu approach channels
description: An improvement study for the BPAN baseline (DQN on the Bintulu chart). Four arms isolate the effect of two concrete, principled improvements: a Dijkstra charted-route PRIOR appended to the observation (the structured-navigation-prior lever shown to help on the Synthetic Port chart), and potential-based reward SHAPING toward the goal (policy-invariant, Ng et al. 1999). Arms: baseline, +chart, +shaping, +chart+shaping. Evaluated across the Study-2 degradation grid; genuinely computed metrics; CTE reported on successful episodes.
seed_policy: SAME 6 seeds per cell (paired). env_seed = 42 + seed.

training.note: all four arms use 150 episodes; a separate chart_long arm (300 eps) is reported as an ablation.

cells_breakdown: 4 arms x 3 conditions x 6 seeds = 72 cells, 30 eval eps each = 2,160 episodes

analysis_plan.omnibus: two-way factorial arm(4) x condition(3) + seed, partial eta^2 on success
analysis_plan.primary_contrast: each improvement vs baseline, per condition (paired Wilcoxon + Holm, Cohen d_z)

pilot: seed 0: baseline clean 17%/harsh 37%; +chart clean 67%/harsh 77%; +shaping clean 43%/harsh 47% -> both improvements help; chart prior dominant.
scope_notes: Improvements are principled and generic (navigation prior, potential shaping), not Bintulu-specific tweaks.
Separate from the Synthetic Port studies; chart-grounded Bintulu case.
